live_research_and_earnings_highlights.headline: Marvell Agrees to Acquire Lumentum in Historic $115B All-Stock Deal; Both Stocks Plunge (~$91B Value Wiped Out)
live_research_and_earnings_highlights.summary: Marvell (MRVL) announced a $115B all-stock acquisition of Lumentum (LITE) to combine optical DSPs with InP lasers. Wall Street slashed ratings (BofA downgraded MRVL to Neutral PT $225 from $400; TD Cowen cut PT in half) citing equity dilution, while LITE plunged >17% as shareholders convert into diluted MRVL stock and optical OEMs (Ciena, Cisco) evaluate independent laser supply.
live_research_and_earnings_highlights.portfolio_action: Supply-chain read-across: Lumentum ceases to be a standalone optical pure-play once merged into Marvell, leaving Coherent (COHR) as the largest independent US vertically integrated 6-inch InP laser and Optical Circuit Switch (OCS) supplier.

live_research_and_earnings_highlights.headline: Coherent (COHR) Reports Record $2.37B Q1 FY27 Revenue (+56% YoY), $2.09 EPS Beat & Signs $20B PhotonLink Hyperscaler LTA
live_research_and_earnings_highlights.source: Coherent Corp. Q1 FY2027 Form 10-Q & Press Release
live_research_and_earnings_highlights.summary: Coherent posted Q1 FY2027 revenue of $2.37B (+50-56% YoY) and adjusted EPS of $2.09 (beating consensus by $0.07), signed a $20B PhotonLink Long-Term Agreement (LTA) with a tier-1 hyperscaler, and raised FY27 revenue growth guidance above 60% (projecting $3.0B+ quarter by Q4 FY27 and $4.0B quarter in FY28).
live_research_and_earnings_highlights.portfolio_action: Supply-chain read-across: Confirms multi-year hyperscaler demand for 6-inch InP CW/EML lasers, 800G/1.6T optical transceivers, and Optical Circuit Switches (OCS), with positive upstream read-across to InP substrates (AXTI) and MOCVD reactors (AIIXY).

live_research_and_earnings_highlights.headline: SemiAnalysis: (1) SpaceX 13GW AI Cloud in 18 Months, (2) GDPx Benchmark Shows Best AI Agent at 12%, (3) Texas Datacenter Permit Risk & ASML Hybrid Bonding Tool
live_research_and_earnings_highlights.source: SemiAnalysis (Dylan Patel / Maya Barkin / Max Kan)
live_research_and_earnings_highlights.summary: Latest SemiAnalysis research highlights: (1) SpaceX/xAI building 13GW of AI compute in 18 months (+50GW global DC buildout in 2027, moving the shortage back to chips); (2) GDPx real-world benchmark where top frontier AI scores just 12% (0% in finance/legal), proving massive test-time compute scaling ahead; (3) Bipartisan 2028 Texas datacenter permit freeze risk; and (4) Patent/roadmap evidence that ASML is building its own Hybrid Bonding tool.
live_research_and_earnings_highlights.portfolio_action: Supply-chain read-across: Reinforces wafer fab equipment and packaging demand (ASML, TSM, DSCSY, LSRCY, ASMIY, ONTO, ATEYY), highlights ERCOT regulatory risk for debt-funded Texas data-center builds (CIFR), and introduces long-term competitive watch on BESIY from ASML.

live_research_and_earnings_highlights.headline: Astera Labs (ALAB) Q3 Revenue Jumps 154% YoY to Record $584.9M; Guides Q4 to $730M-$750M as Scorpio X-Series Passes $1B Annualized
live_research_and_earnings_highlights.summary: Astera Labs doubled Q3 revenue to $584.9M (+154% YoY) and guided Q4 to $730M-$750M as Scorpio X-Series smart fabric switches surpassed $1B annualized run-rate and Aries 7 debuted. Meanwhile, Credo (CRDO) secured OCP approval for two optical telemetry standards and expanded its Oracle AI interconnect deployment.
live_research_and_earnings_highlights.portfolio_action: Supply-chain read-across: Confirms accelerating rack-level scale-up connectivity demand across Active Electrical Cables (CRDO), PCIe/UALink fabric switches (ALAB), and precision silicon MEMS reference clocks (SITM).

live_research_and_earnings_highlights.headline: KLA (Rev +29% YoY, $4.7B Q2 Guide), ASM International (€1.16B Record Q3 Rev on 2nm GAA ALD) & Advantest (Record HBM4/SoC Test Outlook) Beat Estimates
live_research_and_earnings_highlights.source: KLA / ASM International / Advantest Earnings Filings
live_research_and_earnings_highlights.summary: Leading WFE suppliers reported Q3 beats: KLA (KLAC) grew revenue +29% YoY with $936M in quarterly buybacks and guided Q2 to $4.7B +/- $200M; ASM International (ASMIY) hit record €1.16B Q3 revenue on N2 2nm Gate-All-Around ALD orders; and Advantest (ATEYY) raised full-year AI SoC & HBM4 tester guidance.
live_research_and_earnings_highlights.portfolio_action: Supply-chain read-across: Confirms N2 2nm GAA Atomic Layer Deposition (ASMIY, KKSIY), process control metrology (KLAC), and HBM4 burn-in test (ATEYY) capital intensity expansion.
